title: Normalized derived enrichment of integral dg categories
statement: Fix a small universe $u$. Let $C$ be unbounded integral cochain complexes, using the cohomology convention of [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and let $p:E\to N(\Delta^{op})$ in universe $u+2$ be enhanced integral derived coefficients with their derived tensor as in [def-coef-integral-derived-coefficients]. Choose a coherent unit section $U$ as in [def-coef-complete-algebroid]. Write $\mathrm{dgCat}_{\mathbf Z}$ for the category of $u$-small dg categories and dg functors constructed in [lem-coef-dgcat-free-cell-calculus]. A quasi-equivalence is a dg functor that is a quasi-isomorphism on every Hom complex and is essentially surjective on $H^0$; the latter means every target object admits a closed degree-zero arrow from an image object invertible modulo boundaries, using [lem-coef-dgcat-equivalence-cell-calculus]. Let $P$ be the category of pairs $(A,x,y)$ with dg functors preserving the marked objects, and let $H:P\to C$ send a pair to its Hom complex and a functor to its actual chain map. A normalized derived enrichment is one infinity functor $R:N\mathrm{dgCat}_{\mathbf Z}\to\operatorname{Cat}_{\mathbf D(\mathbf Z)}$, using the full subcategory of complete algebroids of [def-coef-complete-algebroid] with object spaces small at $u$, together with a natural assignment of an object point to every $(A,x)$ and a coherent natural equivalence $L\circ NH\simeq\mathrm{Hom}_R$ on $NP$. The object points lie over $R(A)$ and $\mathrm{Hom}_R$ is evaluation of that actual algebroid at its two marked points on every simplex. Include a vertical equivalence from $U$ to $L(\mathbf Z[0])$ in the coefficient fibre. An underlying comparison uses the actual unit-valued ordered-string underlying categories from [lem-coef-algebroid-object-space-fibration], an object assignment $x\mapsto Rx$ with the specified labels, a functor from the closed-arrow category of $A$ to its underlying homotopy category, and bijections $\operatorname{Hom}(Rx,Ry)\cong H^0 A(x,y)$. These send the class of every closed arrow to its own cohomology class, and that underlying arrow has coefficient map equal, up to a specified composition triangle, to $U\simeq L\mathbf Z[0]\xrightarrow{L(c)}LA(x,y)\simeq\mathrm{Hom}_R(Rx,Ry)$ using the same Hom comparison. Every underlying object is isomorphic to one of the assigned $Rx$. The localization property used with this datum is the full coherent universal property [lem-coef-finite-reedy-localization], not the ordinary derived-category universal property.

source.place: Haugseng, Rectification of enriched infinity-categories, Definition 5.1, Theorem 5.4, Definition 5.6, Theorem 5.8 and Example 5.11, integral unbounded case; comparison on mapping objects and the underlying H^0 category.
